1) **Yes**, the card explicitly states: "This ₦22,400 basket could be your **first Kozy Bag — free**."
2) **Yes**, it names the plan "**The Essentials**" at a price of "₦30,000/month".
3) **Yes**, there is a prominent **gold button** ("Make this my first Kozy Bag...") and a text-based "**No thanks**" option next to it.
4) **Yes**, the "**Choose payment method**" section (including Bank Transfer and Pay Online options) is clearly visible immediately below the promotional card.
5) **No significant layout problems.** The page follows a logical vertical flow: Order Summary → Coupon → Upsell Card → Payment Options. The hierarchy is clear, and the dark card effectively breaks up the white space to draw attention to the membership offer without obscuring the payment details below.
